content.text: Section 18 meets or exceeds the preferred position on every coverage line.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 is a dedicated vendor insurance clause that matches the preferred position in full: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5M (Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data), workers' compensation as required by law (plus employer's liability of USD 1M), maintained at Vendor's expense throughout the term and for one year afterward. Clause 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No redline needed.
